svg.aria-label: Three images rendered by the Pixelstorm Verilog
svg.title: Three images rendered by the Pixelstorm Verilog
svg.text: Rendered by the Verilog: three framebuffers read back from RTL simulation
Every pixel below was computed by rtl/ps_sm.v in Icarus Verilog and checked against the golden model and a CPU renderer.
one thread per pixel, no divergence
